arxiv_version_policy.limitation: The source image filenames omit arXiv versions. All unversioned papers keep the default unversioned download and claim no source-version pin; only papers with an explicit validated pdf_override record a pinned arXiv version.

2304.04203.withdrawal_reason: arXiv:2304.04203 (OpenDriver: An Open-Road Driver State Detection Dataset) was withdrawn by the submitting author; the unversioned PDF endpoint returns 404. Withdrawal notice: "Considering that there are flaws in the statistical data of the dataset, all the authors agreed to withdraw the manuscript." Version v1 is pinned for the staged figure.
